headline: Highest risk is medium: MinerU’s MCP/document parsing can feed Perplexity’s browsing context, creating prompt-injection and data-leakage pathways; no direct write-conflict is evident.

A_prompt_injection.rationale: MinerU exposes an MCP Server and processes raw PDFs/images/DOCX/XLSX, while Perplexity ingests uploaded documents and browsing context. If MinerU output is passed into Perplexity through MCP or file upload, attacker-controlled document text can steer Perplexity’s instructions. The pairwise bridge is plausible in default workflows, though not proven by docs.
conditions: IF MinerU output is forwarded into Perplexity via MCP or upload
IF the source document contains instruction-like text or prompt injection
IF Perplexity treats uploaded content as authoritative context
mitigations: Disable automatic forwarding from MinerU to Perplexity
Strip instructions from extracted text before upload
Use a human review step for any document-derived prompt
Restrict Perplexity to summaries, not raw OCR text
requires-engineering: add provenance tags and content filtering

B_data_leakage.rationale: MinerU touches PDFs, images, DOCX, PPTX, XLSX, and OCR text; Perplexity accepts uploaded PDFs/images and sends queries to vendor-only search backends. If the same sensitive document is processed by both, content can flow from local extraction into a third-party inference/search service. This is a default-pathway risk, though not enough evidence for high.
conditions: IF the same sensitive file is uploaded to both agents
IF Perplexity sends uploaded content to vendor search or inference backends
IF the document contains secrets, regulated data, or confidential business material
mitigations: Do not upload sensitive files to Perplexity
Redact secrets before any cross-agent transfer
Use MinerU only on non-sensitive documents
Confirm vendor retention settings before upload
requires-engineering: isolate sensitive workflows from vendor-hosted search

C_capability_conflict.rationale: Both agents can operate concurrently, but neither profile shows filesystem write, git mutation, or unrestricted host execution. MinerU has multi-threaded concurrent inference and Perplexity supports multiple instances, yet the shared mutable-resource overlap needed for serious write conflicts is absent. Uncertainty is low because the relevant write capabilities are explicitly false.
conditions: IF both agents are pointed at the same mutable external resource through an undocumented integration
IF an operator adds a shared writable workspace outside the documented profiles
mitigations: Keep each agent on separate workspaces
Avoid shared git or filesystem targets
Do not add write-capable plugins without review
Use read-only exports between agents
requires-engineering: add locking around any shared mutable resource

D_cascading_error.rationale: MinerU is a document-processing extractor, and Perplexity is an answer engine with live search and citations. If Perplexity consumes MinerU’s extracted text as authoritative input, extraction errors or OCR hallucinations can cascade into polished but wrong answers. The profiles do not show a verification gate, so the interaction is plausible in default usage.
conditions: IF MinerU output is used as Perplexity input without manual verification
IF OCR or layout extraction is imperfect
IF Perplexity presents the derived answer as factual
mitigations: Verify extracted text against the source document
Use Perplexity only for secondary research, not final authority
Add a checklist for OCR-sensitive documents
Require citations back to the original file
requires-engineering: insert a validation stage before downstream use

E_compliance.rationale: Perplexity is vendor-hosted with vendor-only egress, while MinerU is documented as private and fully offline. If regulated documents move from MinerU into Perplexity, residency/retention expectations can diverge. The risk is compliance mismatch rather than a proven violation, and only Perplexity needs citation because the mismatch is driven by its hosted handling.
conditions: IF regulated data is transferred from MinerU into Perplexity
IF the organization requires offline-only or on-prem processing
IF vendor retention or residency terms do not cover the data class
mitigations: Keep regulated data in MinerU only
Review Perplexity privacy and retention settings
Use de-identified excerpts instead of full documents
Obtain a DPA before sending sensitive data
requires-engineering: route regulated workflows to an approved environment
